name: thesis-marketing
description: Remembers your investment thesis and turns it into posts, SEO articles and content plans that point people to it, without ever soliciting investment.

interface.shortDescription: Posts and SEO content built around your thesis
interface.longDescription: Set up your investment thesis once. Thesis Marketing remembers it and writes posts for X, LinkedIn, Telegram, Farcaster, Instagram and Threads, plus SEO articles, a thesis landing page, post ideas and a content calendar. Every draft is checked so it never reads as an offer to invest.
defaultPrompt: Write a LinkedIn post about my thesis
Write an SEO article for my thesis page
